person: Marcus Webb is a 45-year-old physical therapist in Tacoma, laid off from a hospital system when his department was cut, now picking up per diem shifts. He is the household spreadsheet person and checks every figure; his wife wants the money and coverage sorted properly. His group coverage ended at month end and he has a scheduled shoulder MRI in early October that he wants covered. He is working through unemployment, severance, COBRA and a marketplace plan and wants every number shown with its method.
